verdict.rationale: Temporal's core model is Workflows and Activities written as ordinary functions/methods in supported languages (TypeScript, Python, etc.), with automatic checkpointing/durable execution and crash recovery built into the runtime, corroborated by community users describing it as modeling business logic as ordinary code with side effects in Activities. This directly matches the story of code-based workflow authoring versus YAML/DSL. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark or critique specifically addressing 'no DSL' claim beyond community anecdotes, and some community feedback notes friction with error/anomaly handling in practice.
